tasks.title: Prototype KO->EN back-translation
tasks.rationale: round trip needs a back-translator; sample N for self-consistency

tasks.title: Build hybrid SNOMED search (lexical + embeddings)
tasks.rationale: the linkage check needs ranked retrieval over FSN+synonyms

tasks.title: Define round-trip confidence metric (rank/similarity)
tasks.rationale: turn linkage into a calibrated per-item score

tasks.title: Add per-translation confidence score
tasks.rationale: needed for triage

tasks.title: Investigate per-translation confidence signal
tasks.rationale: the Output concept needs a confidence to triage review

tasks.title: Build a SNOMED semantic index (new function node)
tasks.rationale: Index FSN+synonyms for back-translation lookup; today only data-pair embeddings exist.

tasks.title: Compare SNOMED indexing strategies (dense / lexical / hybrid)
tasks.rationale: Retrieval quality of the round trip depends on the index; try variants.

tasks.title: Ingest the Korean SNOMED extension as gold KO<->concept pairs
tasks.rationale: snomedct-kr gives gold pairs to drive + evaluate the method.

tasks.title: Define a closeness/distance metric for retrieved concepts
tasks.rationale: Need rank + similarity + hierarchy distance to score how close we got.

tasks.title: Compare rerankers: cross-encoder vs LLM vs calculated metrics
tasks.rationale: Lookup returns many candidates; the reranker choice drives precision.

tasks.title: Obtain the International-edition RF2 release locally (EN FSN+synonyms source)
tasks.rationale: Decision: local RF2 for fast access; only the KR extension is local today.

tasks.title: Define the index DataObject meta schema (rf2_release, embedding_model, strategy, dim, counts)
tasks.rationale: Make the index's build config legible + reproducible across embedding models.

tasks.title: Compose the back-translation-confidence flow (after building blocks exist)
tasks.rationale: No existing flow is adaptable (all are translate->evaluate); the needed function nodes don't exist yet, so build the blocks first, then wire the flow.

tasks.title: SME-labelled error-detection test
tasks.rationale: Back-translation can't flag MT errors under string/embedding labels (note-error-detection); the real test needs genuinely-wrong candidates with human (SME) ACCEPTABLE/PARTIAL/WRONG labels.

tasks.title: Compare hierarchy-trained embeddings (HiT/OnT) vs BGE-M3 for retrieval
tasks.rationale: Test SNOMED-hierarchy-trained hyperbolic encoders (example_ret_script) as the index embedder; do they improve back-translation concept recall? (in progress).

tasks.title: Hierarchy-coherence confidence signal
tasks.rationale: do clustered top-K predict a correct match? (weak alone, +orthogonal to margin)

tasks.title: Cross-hierarchy mismatch as a structural error flag
tasks.rationale: flag when expected semantic tag != retrieved concept's tag; embedding-independent

tasks.title: Non-generative direct cross-lingual verification
tasks.rationale: skip the error-laundering LLM; score candidate KO directly vs concept EN / KO reference

tasks.title: Extend Korean references via Athena 'Maps to' (EDI/KCD7/LOINC -> SNOMED)
tasks.rationale: reference-based validation only covers the ~39k KR-edition concepts (~11% of SNOMED); Athena mappings could extend references to untranslated concepts. Needs the Athena bundle restored + relationship-path code; filter for map quality.

tasks.title: Concept-context in the translation prompt (tag/parents)
tasks.rationale: does SNOMED context improve EN->KO? Neutral overall, helps ambiguous tail (organism/qualifier); context must be fenced

tasks.title: Prompt optimisation (GEPA) with conditional context access
tasks.rationale: blind judge shows parent context wins ~2:1 on ambiguous types (organism 69%, qualifier 66%, finding 57%) but HURTS concrete ones (body structure 26%, disorder 44%); GEPA should learn conditional context access by concept type. Productionise a context-aware translate node.

tasks.title: SME spot-check of context value on the ambiguous tail
tasks.rationale: chrF/sem-to-gold may understate context value (penalises valid divergence); confirm with human rating on organisms/qualifier values

tasks.title: Fix exemplar retrieval: self-concept exclusion + leak audit
tasks.rationale: note-2 in translation-prompt-context showed 87.9% of test terms had their gold Korean among retrieved exemplars; drop exemplars whose SCTID/tag-stripped EN matches the query and verify 0% gold-in-exemplar before any further eval is trusted

tasks.title: Structure the batch-1 SME feedback into machine-readable labels
tasks.rationale: the ~100 SME reviews (verdicts + qualitative comments + corrected translations) must be in a versioned, per-term dataobject before judge calibration and taxonomy mining can run on them

tasks.title: Mine recurring EN components and score KO rendering consistency
tasks.rationale: reference-free metric: same English component should map to one Korean rendering; validate flags against KR-extension gold + SME labels, surface top divergent components as glossary/SME candidates

tasks.title: Re-run headline guide comparison on the clean harness
tasks.rationale: hand v5_1 vs GEPA+Fable vs induced guide on leakage-fixed kr_test_split AND the ~100 extension-external SME terms; establishes the trustworthy ranking that replaces the inflated 55.6%/58.1%

tasks.title: Measure judge-vs-SME agreement
tasks.rationale: the whole automated loop (GEPA feedback, test scores) rests on the judge; ~100 SME verdicts let us measure kappa/correlation and find the judge-high/SME-reject blind spots GEPA may be exploiting

tasks.title: Build the SME error taxonomy
tasks.rationale: bucket qualitative feedback into recurring failure classes (register, loanword convention, word order, anatomy, orthography); feeds GEPA feedback text, judge prompt patches, and batch stratification

tasks.title: Hierarchy-derived exemplars vs semantic retrieval
tasks.rationale: translated parents/siblings from the KR extension as style/template anchors vs BGE top-k; must run on the leakage-fixed harness since siblings-with-gold is exactly the regime the leak inflated

tasks.title: Build SME batch 2 (40/40/20 design) + structured feedback form
tasks.rationale: 40% stratified-random from the untranslated frontier, 40% actively sampled where signals disagree (judge divergence, retrieval margin, consistency flags), 20% reliability repeats/overlap; dedupe near-variants; form captures accept/edit/reject + error category + correction

tasks.title: Combine confidence signals into a calibrated triage scorer
tasks.rationale: combine direct cross-lingual similarity, retrieval cosine/margin, hierarchy coherence, consistency flags and judge score against SME accept/reject labels; report precision/coverage — % of terms skipping review at <=5% auto-accept error; feeds gate-1

tasks.title: Clean GEPA re-optimisation in the pooled-excluded regime
tasks.rationale: the existing GEPA(Fable) guide was optimised near-exemplar-free but the clean eval retrieves (leak-free) exemplars — a train/eval mismatch; re-run GEPA with the self-excluded pooled retrieval so the comparison vs hand v5_1 (36.3% clean) is fair; also lift budget (auto=medium, higher Fable judge cap)

tasks.title: Add a KO↔KO semantic partial-credit scorer to the eval recipe
tasks.rationale: task-E showed exact-match zeroes ~18% of all items that are valid synonyms (chrF only partially credits, avg 0.548); a KO↔KO BGE-M3 semantic scorer recovers them. Promote scripts/analysis/graded_xlingual_closeness.py logic to a flow scorer node so every clean comparison (task-26) reports partial credit; validate τ against task-24 SME ratings first.

tasks.title: Hand-encode SME Q&A rulings into style guide v6.0 + hard rules
tasks.rationale: The 15-question answers are deterministic knowledge (canonical modality table, contrast-first, -graphy→조영/조영술 vs images→영상, native anatomy, structure-of, approaches, transliteration policy). Encoding by hand banks the win without optimisation risk; freeze+enforce in configs/ko/hard_rules/ko.yaml stops GEPA undoing them.

tasks.title: Build SME gold assets: multi-reference gold + train/dev/held-out splits from batch-1+2
tasks.rationale: 33 confirmed + 67 corrected batch-2 rows (+ batch-1 labels) = ~200 in-domain register-correct references — the first trustworthy optimisation signal. Held-out slice never touches GEPA.

tasks.title: Add contrast-hallucination detector node (source-conditional)
tasks.rationale: 조영제 사용/미사용 invented when the source has no contrast mention: 2 of 5 SME Wrongs, reproduces deterministically. Source-conditional so it cannot be a surface hard rule; wanted both as GEPA metric penalty and production audit flag (sibling of transliteration_detect).

tasks.title: Calibrate the optimisation metric against SME ratings
tasks.rationale: SME boundary: spacing+synonym diffs acceptable, word-order not. Verify candidate metrics rank Correct/Acceptable > Partial > Wrong on batch-2 before GEPA optimises the number.

tasks.title: Baseline runs: v5.1 vs v6.0 on held-out SME gold
tasks.rationale: Quantify the deterministic win; v6.0 must ≥ v5.1 to become the GEPA seed.

tasks.title: GEPA re-opt seeded from v6.0 with Opus 5 reflection on SME gold splits
tasks.rationale: The 'clean GEPA re-opt' flagged by fable_gepa_judge_v1: seed from strength, in-domain gold, frozen hard rules, calibrated metric. Promotion gated on beating v6.0 on held-out.

tasks.title: Production run over the 5,796 imaging pool with winning prompt + audit pass
tasks.rationale: After promotion: fold SME-corrected pairs into the exemplar pool (re-index), filter/annotate the 11 inactive concepts, translate the full pool, rank low-confidence terms (transliteration echo, contrast-hallucination, acceptability judge) for the SME's sampling, include synonyms column.

gates.description: terminologist confirms the confidence signal tracks real review need
